meta.title: Tower
meta.description: Mission planning, isolated worktrees, worker/reviewer agents, and review-gated merges. Off equals uninstalling Tower: no tools, presets or skills remain.

tower.title: Tower host
tower.summary: Mission planning, worktree isolation, the mode guard, the health contract and the recovery escape.
tower.disables: Off equals uninstalling Tower: no tools, presets or skills remain.

tower-skills.title: Tower skills
tower-skills.summary: Playbooks for worker/reviewer agents and recovery after a blocked merge.
tower-skills.disables: The three Tower skills leave the catalog; the worker/reviewer protocol sections and every mission tool keep working.

tower-batch.title: Evidence batches
tower-batch.summary: Group missions into finite evidence batches and close them against required checks and receipts.
tower-batch.disables: tower_batch is not registered; missions, gates and merges are unaffected.

tower-import.title: Legacy import
tower-import.summary: Import a Tower Codex legacy state file and audit its snapshot-to-mission mapping.
tower-import.disables: tower_import_legacy and tower_legacy_map are not registered; new state is unaffected.

tower-leases.title: Advisory leases
tower-leases.summary: Coordinate heavy per-repository work with advisory resource leases.
tower-leases.disables: tower_resource is not registered; nothing else depends on a lease.

tower-tests.title: Test discovery
tower-tests.summary: Run the worktree's declared test discovery and record a receipt for the mission tip.
tower-tests.disables: tower_test is not registered and no receipt can be recorded; with gates.requireTests:true planning/mode entry is rejected with an explanation.

tower-board.title: Mission board
tower-board.summary: Write the human-readable MISSIONS.md board next to the state so a human can read the mission list without a tool call.
tower-board.disables: MISSIONS.md is not written or refreshed, so an existing board goes stale; mission tools, gates and every other capability keep working.

tower-archive.title: Mission archive
tower-archive.summary: Move terminal missions and their linked records into the on-disk archive so state.json stops carrying their full history.
tower-archive.disables: Terminal missions stay hot in state.json, so the hot state keeps growing; merges, gates and every other capability keep working and nothing is deleted.

tower-hmr.title: Development hot reload
tower-hmr.summary: Development-only tooling for a linked dev profile: register tower_reload and /tower reload so a plugin edit can be reconciled without a manual restart.
tower-hmr.disables: tower_reload and /tower reload are unavailable, so a linked-profile reload is triggered outside Tower; a normal profile behaves exactly as before. Development tooling, shipped off on purpose.

preset-tower-worker.title: Tower Worker preset
preset-tower-worker.summary: Declares the Tower Worker preset: the mission protocol plus the filesystem, shell and Tower tools a worker runs inside its assigned worktree.
preset-tower-worker.disables: tower_spawn cannot start a worker without it.

preset-tower-reviewer.title: Tower Reviewer preset
preset-tower-reviewer.summary: Declares the Tower Reviewer preset: read-only independent review that inspects the mission diff, verifies scope and acceptance, and returns a verdict.
preset-tower-reviewer.disables: The reviewer cannot be dispatched. Supported while review.requireReview is false; with the gate on planning/mode entry is locked with an explanatory error.

tower-ui.title: Tower UI
tower-ui.summary: Shows Tower tool cards, a composer-dock tower summary, and a transient Tower status strip in the web client.
tower-ui.disables: The web UI plugin does not load: no tool cards, composer-dock summary or status strip; host tools, missions, state and the board are unaffected.
